name: Furnace Ignitor Replacement
description: The hot-surface ignitor lights the burners. It's a common wear item, typically failing every 3–7 years.

name: Flame Sensor Cleaning or Replacement
description: The flame sensor confirms burners are lit. A dirty sensor is one of the most common causes of short cycling.
signals: Furnace lights then shuts off quickly

name: Limit Switch Replacement
description: The high-limit switch shuts the furnace down when it overheats. Replacement restores safe operation after airflow issues are fixed.
signals: Furnace shuts off before reaching temperature

name: Pressure Switch Replacement
description: The pressure switch verifies the inducer is moving combustion gases safely before ignition is allowed.
signals: Furnace tries to start but stops before ignition

name: Inducer Motor Replacement
description: The inducer motor pulls combustion gases through the heat exchanger and out the vent. A failed motor prevents safe operation.

name: Gas Valve Replacement
description: The gas valve controls fuel flow to the burners. Failures require licensed service due to combustion safety requirements.
signals: Burners fail to ignite with good ignitor

name: Blower Motor Replacement
description: The blower motor moves heated air through your ductwork. ECM motors cost more but run more efficiently.

name: Control Board Replacement
description: The control board manages ignition sequence, safety checks, and blower operation. Board failures cause varied error codes.
